stemMd: Every sculpture loaned abroad is insured. No uninsured work may leave the storage building. Some sculptures remain uninsured. Which must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some sculptures may not leave the storage building.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every insured sculpture is loaned abroad.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No sculpture may be displayed inside the storage building.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every work in storage is uninsured.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Some sculptures have been loaned abroad.

explanationMd: The stated uninsured sculptures exist and fall under the rule prohibiting uninsured works from leaving. That gives the particular conclusion. The foreign-loan rule is compatible with there being no current loans.

distractorRationale.d: Storage location does not imply insurance status.
distractorRationale.b: Insurance is not sufficient for a foreign loan.
distractorRationale.c: The rule restricts leaving, not internal display.
distractorRationale.e: No actual foreign loan is asserted.
